2 Games in 1 - Golden Nugget Casino + Te.name: 2 Games In 1: Golden Nugget Casino & Texas Hold 'Em Poker
2 Games in 1 - Golden Nugget Casino + Te.summary: 2 Games in 1: Golden Nugget Casino / Texas Hold 'Em Poker is a 2005 game for the Game Boy Advance. It is a double pack re-release of Golden Nugget Casino and Texas Hold 'Em Poker.

Barbie Superpack - Secret Agent + Groovy.name: Barbie Superpack: Secret Agent / Groovy Games
Barbie Superpack - Secret Agent + Groovy.summary: Barbie Secret Agent and Barbie Groovy Games on a single cartridge.

Crash Bandicoot - The Huge Adventure.name: Crash Bandicoot: The Huge Adventure
Crash Bandicoot - The Huge Adventure.summary: Tired of endlessly doing battle with meddling bandicoots, the nefarious Dr. Neo Cortex shrinks the entire Earth, and Crash and Coco along with it, to the size of a wumpa fruit. Luckily, Coco invents a machine to reverse the effects, but she needs crystals from around the world to power it. Crash must retrieve the crystals to help return the entire planet to its natural state. Experience Crash's biggest adventure yet, with gameplay modes ranging from side-scrolling to 3D chase levels to aerial dogfight combat sequences. Battle your way through over 20 huge levels and six unique locations to defeat Cortex and save the world.

Jurassic Park III - Park Builder.name: Jurassic Park III: Park Builder
Jurassic Park III - Park Builder.summary: Clearly, the folks who built the original park were guilty of a few oversights. Think you can do any better? Try your hand at plotting out all of the details of the creation and management of a dinosaur park in JURASSIC PARK III: Park Builder. A strategy-simulation title of the highest caliber, the game leaves you in charge of 100 dinosaur species you have the task of placing them and maintaining their health. Of course, there's also the matter of the restaurants, shops, rides, and other attractions. If the park you create is too boring, poorly maintained, or excessively expensive, no one will show up, so you'd better use some seriously discerning judgment. In addition to managing the park, you'll have to pick up DNA strands from throughout the park to create new dinosaurs to keep the people coming back. Does it sound like too much to handle? Just wait until one of your prehistoric pals escapes on opening day.

Kururin Paradise.name: Kururin Paradise
Kururin Paradise.summary:
Kururin Paradise is the sequel to Kuru Kuru Kururin, offering more levels to navigate with the Helirin. The plot begins with a troupe of magicians arriving in Kururin's quiet village, followed by the strange disappearance of Kururin's family and mentor. To rescue them, Kururin must travel through new worlds while taking on minigames set up by the mysterious magicians. New to this game are branching paths unlocked by finding hidden keys in specific levels. The game also includes a challenge mode, multiplayer mode, and even bonus 'magic tricks' that can be performed with the GBA system.
Although the game initially released only in Japan, Kururin Paradise later received an international release through the Nintendo Classics service.

Naruto - Ninja Council 2.name: Naruto: Ninja Council 2
Naruto - Ninja Council 2.summary: Action game, based on the Shonen Jump manga. This sequel to the very first Naruto game on the GBA (the second game was a much different simulation/adventure) has three-times the amount of stages and characters twice the size. The action is streamlined and more dynamic. Players can transform into Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura and use their abilities to defeat the scrolling stages. The game also utilizes the link cable for a two-player co-op mode and for a four-player battle mode.

Pirates of the Caribbean - Dead Man's Ch.name: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
Pirates of the Caribbean - Dead Man's Ch.summary: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest is an action-adventure game based on the film of the same name, starring Jack Sparrow.

PukuPuku Tennen Kairanban.name: PukuPuku Tennen Kairanban
PukuPuku Tennen Kairanban.summary: PukuPuku Tennen Kairanban is an Action game, published by Victor Interactive Software, which was released in Japan in 2002.

SpongeBob's Atlantis SquarePantis.name: SpongeBob's Atlantis Squarepantis
SpongeBob's Atlantis SquarePantis.summary: SpongeBob's Atlantis SquarePantis is a SpongeBob SquarePants video game based on the television series series and the Atlantis SquarePantis TV movie. This is the first SpongeBob game that is based on a made-for-TV movie. The game was released October 23, 2007. It is also the first by Altron. The next one would be Drawn to Life: SpongeBob SquarePants Edition. This was the last SpongeBob game to be released for the PlayStation 2 and Game Boy Advance.

Yu-Gi-Oh! - Worldwide Edition - Stairway.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Worldwide Edition: Stairway to the Destined Duel
Yu-Gi-Oh! - Worldwide Edition - Stairway.summary: Yu-Gi-Oh! Worldwide Edition: Stairway to the Destined Duel is a censored version of Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters 6 Expert 2 (including the card artworks). Released in both Japanese and English, it is set during the Battle City arc. The player duels characters from the anime and manga, participating in a few tournaments and duel single opponents they come across on the map screen. Cards are awarded for various reasons, including defeating opponents, winning tournaments and free cards with the Duelist Weekly magazine. This game contains around 1,000 cards.
